characters.name: REIN
characters.description: Väike oranž rebane pehme koheva sabaga, seljas roheline t-särk ja sinised lühikesed püksid, suured uudishimulikud silmad ning sõbralik naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

characters.name: KATI
characters.description: Väike heleroosa-pruun karu ümarate kõrvadega, seljas kollane suvekleit, suured säravad silmad ning soe rõõmus naeratus. Armas multifilmistiil.

locations.name: Päikeseline aed
locations.description: Sunny garden with lush green lawn, a small round wooden table in the middle, a vibrant flowerbed with red and yellow blossoms behind the table, a light wooden fence, and clear blue summer sky with warm sunlight. Bright cheerful color palette, simple clean background, cartoon illustration style.

pages.scene: Rein the small orange fox wearing a green t-shirt and blue shorts, and Kati the small bear wearing a yellow summer dress, stand happily on the green lawn in the sunny garden. A small wooden table is next to them. Clear blue sky above.
Rein and Kati stand near the wooden table in the garden, looking at each other excitedly with happy expressions and raised hands as if they just got a great fun idea.
Kati the small bear kneels down happily on the green grass near the wooden table, picking up smooth round grey stones from the lawn and smiling cheerfully.
Rein the small fox walks over to the wooden table carrying a set of colorful paint pots and small paintbrushes, placing them onto the wooden table.
Kati sits at the wooden table, carefully holding a paintbrush and painting a smooth round stone bright red. Rein stands next to her, watching attentively with a smile.
Rein the small fox holds a fine paintbrush and carefully paints small yellow polka dots onto the red painted stone sitting on the wooden table. Kati watches happily.
Rein and Kati sit together at the wooden table, proudly admiring the freshly painted stone that now looks like a cute bright ladybug sitting on the table in front of them.
Rein and Kati gently place their painted ladybug stone into the colorful flowerbed next to bright flowers, decorating the garden.
Rein the fox and Kati the bear stand side by side next to the decorated flowerbed, smiling brightly, cheering with raised arms and feeling very happy with their creation.
